question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **wondered** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb "**wondered**" means to have a feeling of curiosity or doubt. (जिज्ञासा या संदेह की भावना होना) • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as the sentence talks about a person's thoughts. • The past tense form of "wonder" is "wondered". • The sentence would make grammatical sense with "**wondered**" in it. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. Complete passage: *Redwing had read (1) somewhere__ that one of his favourite writers, Ernest Hemingway, had been asked what was the best (2) __training __for a novelist. He had said "an unhappy childhood". Redwing had enjoyed a fine time growing up, but he **(3) **__**wondered** __if this whole (4) ______ was unfolding more like a novel, and would be (5) ______ on one person, one character, the guy in charge: him. Maybe you got a happy childhood and then an unhappy adulthood, and that's how novels worked.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Wasted **means to use something in an unproductive or inefficient way. (किसी चीज़ का अनुत्पादक या अकुशल तरीके से उपयोग करना) • **Wandered **means to walk or move aimlessly or without a fixed direction. (लक्ष्यहीन या निश्चित दिशा के बिना चलना या घूमना) • **Welded **means joining two pieces of metal together by heating them until they melt and pressing them together. (धातु के दो टुकड़ों को पिघलने तक गर्म करके और दबाकर एक साथ जोड़ना) 1e9:Tf4b, The correct answer is: **Expedition**
